indicator: USAC ACP Enrollment and Claims Tracker - total households enrolled, national (weekly snapshots 2022-01-03 through 2024-02-08)
exclusion_reason: No FRED/ALFRED mirror exists for ACP enrollment (searched 2026-07-31; FRED's Monthly Treasury Statement release carries 6 aggregate series only), and USAC republishes its tracker at a single current vintage with no archive of previously published versions, so the first-print recoverability test cannot be run. Unit serves dose-response arms (no scoring), not accuracy arms.
